description: The Target carries a radar warning receiver (RWR): select it and watch 'Perceived Mode' in the Entity Inspector. This shot is fired in TWS (track-while-scan): the radar keeps scanning, so the Target hears only search sweeps, and its first real warning is the missile's own seeker going active, about 40 s before impact. Set Launch mode to STT and Reset: the radar locks the Target before it fires, so the RWR shows Lock about 90 s before impact. The trade: an STT track is more accurate (watch the datalink error when the seeker goes active).
